numeric_contract.duration_storage: store every captured duration as a nonnegative integer nanosecond difference from time.monotonic_ns; generation path duration must be strictly positive
numeric_contract.budget_storage: compare integer elapsed sums to exactly 2000000000 nanoseconds; equality passes and strict greater-than is overage
numeric_contract.raw_storage: for each method-unit recompute bound score_attack_raw once over that unit's complete accepted finding sequence: integer severity weights plus twice its integer unique-cell count; require the SDK float finite nonnegative and exactly integral, store integer R_m(u), and aggregate R_m=sum_u R_m(u); define retry-tail raw only as sum_u[R_retry(u)-R_ahcms(u)]
numeric_contract.decision_arithmetic: all raw/elapsed sums, floor-half sensitivity and cross products use Python integers; ratios are display diagnostics computed only after their positive-denominator branch passes

sampling_frame.manifest_generation: exactly once per canonical attempt: use secrets.randbelow rejection sampling to draw 3 unique masters per profile, one independent uniform Fisher-Yates capture permutation over all 9 units, and an independent uniform Fisher-Yates arm permutation for every unit-path; write and fsync complete SAMPLING.json before capture
sampling_frame.retry_rule: never redraw any master, capture order or arm order because of identities, traces, timing, failure or outcome; a crash consumes the canonical scientific attempt
sampling_frame.master_draw: for each profile draw master=1000000000+secrets.randbelow(8000000000000000000), rejecting duplicates until exactly 3 unique masters exist
sampling_frame.capture_order: apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to all 9 profile-master units and capture in that interleaved order
sampling_frame.arm_order: within every trace unit and path slot, apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to arms 24,8,1
sampling_frame.outcome_blinding: manifest, code, endpoint, comparison, sensitivity and thresholds are fsynced before capture; no redraw, exclusion or threshold change may depend on captured outcomes
sampling_frame.sampling_interpretation: an exact fixed-sample matched-trace comparison over nine freshly randomized controlled units; not a target-population or target-model probability claim

matched_trace_unit.definition: one q-independent profile-master potential-outcome table with 16 path slots and fresh prefix arms 24,8,1 at every slot
matched_trace_unit.process_boundary: each profile-master unit runs in one fresh spawned child process; no evaluated method is executed during capture
matched_trace_unit.generation_arm_record: for each arm start time.monotonic_ns immediately before generation_environment_construction checkpoint; end immediately after the interaction loop and final generation_interaction_complete checkpoint but before exact-prefix extraction or selection; then join the elapsed value to the subsequently derived candidate-or-drop object
matched_trace_unit.replay_record: for every exact eligible returned candidate start time.monotonic_ns immediately before replay_environment_construction checkpoint; end immediately after the interaction loop and final replay_interaction_complete checkpoint but before final trace export, predicates, signature or scorer; then join the elapsed value to the subsequently derived scorer output
matched_trace_unit.retry_trace: capture continues through all 16 path slots regardless of first point-ledger no-fit so the post-trigger tail is observed once and can be truncated by the absorbing projection
matched_trace_unit.policy_projection: after capture ends, every method walks the same stored table by path slot; policy state, replay admission and absorption only select or truncate stored outcomes and cannot alter them
matched_trace_unit.missing_rule: any missing arm, timeout, child failure, malformed attribution or missing eligible-return replay invalidates the entire profile-master trace and joint result
matched_trace_unit.support_rule: every method is capped at 16 slots and may request only 24,8,1; no projection may escape capture support

timer_endpoint_table.generation_end: time read after last completed in-loop generation_interaction_complete checkpoint and before indexed_exact_flags/choose_return_prefix
timer_endpoint_table.generation_included: checkpoint canonical-JSON snapshot serialization, fresh environment construction, reset, in-loop trace exports, interactions, suffix/cumulative-cost updates, garbage collection, sleep, preemption and scheduling delay occurring between timer reads
timer_endpoint_table.generation_excluded: pre-timer host/message construction; post-timer exact-prefix extraction, candidate selection, transition, candidate/path assembly, publication checkpoints and artifact serialization/fsync
timer_endpoint_table.replay_end: time read after last completed in-loop replay_interaction_complete checkpoint and before final trace export/evaluation/scorer
timer_endpoint_table.replay_included: checkpoint canonical-JSON snapshot serialization, fresh environment construction, reset, in-loop trace exports, interactions, suffix updates, garbage collection, sleep, preemption and scheduling delay occurring between timer reads
timer_endpoint_table.replay_excluded: post-timer final trace export, exact flags, replay-evaluation checkpoint, predicates, cell signature, scorer, publication and artifact serialization/fsync
timer_endpoint_table.interpretation: captured elapsed intervals at historical brackets; not CPU service time, scheduler-free work, actual offline-method wall-clock, target latency, cancellation or remote-deadline proof

inherited_controller.hcms_policy: initialize state 24, propose state, return longest exact prefix in 24,8,1, set state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix), and set state=1 after exact ineligible drop
inherited_controller.replay_admission: accept an exact eligible candidate only if cumulative inherited point replay charge including it is at most 2.0 seconds
inherited_controller.generation_admission: start a projected path only when observed remaining projected captured generation-path elapsed exceeds the inherited 0.1-second point reserve
inherited_controller.status: all fields inherited and identical between AHCMS and retry removal; none receives contribution credit
inherited_controller.known_limit: point replay/generation charges and captured elapsed endpoints are controlled-harness mechanisms, not target tail guarantees

ahcms_absorbing.after_first_replay_no_fit: terminate permanently and return current accepted candidate prefix

hcms_retry_removal.after_first_replay_no_fit: continue to next path until inherited path or generation cap

fixed8_absorbing.proposal: always propose min(8,current monotone state), initialized to 8
fixed8_absorbing.transition: state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); exact ineligible drop sets state=1; first replay no-fit absorbs
fixed8_absorbing.status: specified simple comparator, not a component removal

fixed24_no_salvage_absorbing.transition: remain 24 after exact ineligible drop; first replay no-fit absorbs
fixed24_no_salvage_absorbing.status: specified simple comparator, not a component removal

resource_accounting.selected_paths: P_m(u) is ordered selected slots through and including a first replay-ledger no-fit path; paths after absorption or another inherited terminal condition are excluded
resource_accounting.per_unit_generation_elapsed_formula: T_m(u)=sum_{t in P_m(u)} g_ns[u,t,a_m(u,t)] where every g_ns uses the exact generation timer bracket
resource_accounting.aggregate_generation_elapsed_formula: T_m=sum_u T_m(u); this is a projected captured-elapsed sum over independently captured intervals
resource_accounting.accepted_candidates: A_m(u) is ordered multiset of exact eligible candidate occurrences admitted by inherited point replay ledger; no-fit and later unselected trace occurrences are excluded
resource_accounting.per_unit_replay_elapsed_formula: L_m(u)=sum_{c in A_m(u)} ell_ns[u,c] where every ell_ns uses the exact replay timer bracket and empty sum is 0
resource_accounting.strict_boundary: exact equality T_m(u)=2000000000 or L_m(u)=2000000000 is not overage; only strict greater-than counts
resource_accounting.interpretation: T and L are projected sums of stored captured elapsed intervals, not live method wall-clock, CPU work, target latency, cancellation or remote deadline certificates

scheduler_sensitivity.purpose: bounded stress against retry-tail-specific scheduling/controller elapsed inflation; not a claim that arbitrary scheduling noise is removed
scheduler_sensitivity.tail_elapsed: T_tail=T_retry-T_ahcms, required nonnegative from the shared-prefix projection
scheduler_sensitivity.raw_rule: retain all retry raw R_retry while discounting elapsed; do not remove any recovered raw
scheduler_sensitivity.scope: confirmation is robust only to this prespecified 50-percent retry-tail elapsed discount; greater or systematic asymmetry remains a limitation

decision_totality.elapsed_domain: every selected g_ns is positive integer, every required ell_ns is nonnegative integer, and aggregate T_m is positive for all four complete projections; violation is invalid measurement evidence
decision_totality.raw_domain: every per-unit and aggregate scorer result is finite, nonnegative and exactly integral; require R_ahcms(u)<=R_retry(u)
decision_totality.zero_retry_raw: if R_retry=0, exact prefix identity requires R_ahcms=R_tail=0; completed valid attempt DISCONFIRMS and Delta_E/rho_raw/rho_tail are NA_zero_retry_raw
decision_totality.positive_retry_zero_ahcms: if R_retry>0 and R_ahcms=0, nominal and sensitivity primary inequalities plus retention disconfirm because their left sides are zero and positive-retry right sides are positive
decision_totality.zero_ahcms_zero_simple_positive_retry: if R_ahcms=R_simple=0 with R_retry>0, joint result disconfirms through primary and retention; simple efficiency cross-product remains defined and retired rho_simple is NA_zero_simple_raw
decision_totality.positive_retry_raw: only when R_retry>0 may display Delta_E=(R_ahcms/T_ahcms)/(R_retry/T_retry), rho_raw=R_ahcms/R_retry and rho_tail=R_retry_tail/R_retry
decision_totality.retention_identity: R_retry_tail=sum_u[R_retry(u)-R_ahcms(u)] with each marginal nonnegative, exactly R_retry=R_ahcms+R_retry_tail and rho_raw=1-rho_tail; rho_tail is consistency not independent evidence
decision_totality.legacy_rho_simple: retired from all decisions; if emitted and max specified simple raw is zero report NA_zero_simple_raw
decision_totality.decision_order: validate evidence/completeness; apply zero-retry branch; evaluate positive-retry nominal, retention, tail and half-tail sensitivity; evaluate AHCMS feasibility; evaluate both specified simple controls

occam_rule.scope_limit: these two preregistered policies test two named simplifications only; they do not exhaust reduced global path caps or every simpler policy
occam_rule.feasible: F_m is true exactly when O_G(m)=0 and O_R(m)=0 on all nine projections
occam_rule.infeasible_simple: complete simple with F_s=false remains published but cannot dominate feasible AHCMS under constrained endpoint
occam_rule.efficiency_materiality: for every feasible specified simple s require 10*R_ahcms*T_s >= 11*R_s*T_ahcms; denominator-free and defined at R_s=0
occam_rule.pareto_dominance: specified simple s Pareto-dominates AHCMS exactly when F_s=true, R_s>=R_ahcms, T_s<=T_ahcms and at least one raw/elapsed inequality strict
occam_rule.confirmation: AHCMS feasible; every specified simple complete; each specified simple either infeasible or passes materiality and does not Pareto-dominate AHCMS
occam_rule.unresolved_alternative: a reduced global path cap is an acknowledged unevaluated simpler alternative and no global Occam-optimality claim is allowed

historical_profile.role: retrospective engineering profile only; not fresh confirmation
historical_profile.endpoint: all seconds and ratios below use sums of path_cost_s at the exact historical generation-path bracket; whole-cell generation_elapsed_s is excluded

contribution_components.single_role: terminate future path attempts immediately after first otherwise-exact candidate cannot fit inherited cumulative replay ledger
contribution_components.measured_bottleneck: sealed HCMS primary traces contain 146 retry-tail paths, 18.36650123470462862 seconds at the exact path timer, and one 18-raw recovery; exact-bracket nominal ratio is 1.362095216773 and half-tail-discount ratio is 1.180818355750
contribution_components.confirmation_predicate: fresh matched traces pass nominal and half-tail-discount efficiency, retention, nominal and discounted tail support, AHCMS zero overages, and specified simple-control endpoint

unclaimed_diagnostics.replay_envelope: not AHCMS behavior, novelty, component count or primary comparison
unclaimed_diagnostics.atomic_gate: not AHCMS behavior, novelty, component count or primary comparison
unclaimed_diagnostics.q_dependent_fixtures: forbidden as efficacy or component-necessity evidence
unclaimed_diagnostics.global_occam: not claimed; fixed8 and fixed24 do not exhaust every simple policy

phase3.evaluation_design: three fresh q-independent matched potential traces per profile; methods are deterministic projections, so no method order/predecessor exists
phase3.primary_metric: aggregate integer raw per projected captured generation-path elapsed nanosecond
phase3.primary_comparison: ahcms_absorbing versus hcms_retry_removal on same nine traces

decision_bands.confirm: every validity, positive-retry, nominal, retention, tail, half-tail sensitivity, AHCMS feasibility and specified simple-control predicate passes
decision_bands.disconfirm: complete valid traces exist but retry raw is zero or any materiality, retention, tail, sensitivity, AHCMS overage or specified simple-control predicate fails
decision_bands.invalid: sampling, trace completeness, attribution, support, timeout, numeric domain, evidence identity or publication invariant fails
decision_bands.inconclusive: only external interruption with no complete fixed-sample result; absent no-fit on complete traces is disconfirm

target_confidence_bridge.source_facts: generation and each model-guardrail replay phase receive 9000 seconds; replay cumulative across returned candidates; attack cannot cancel in-flight RemoteEnv operation
required_before_attack_mutation: source-compliant 9000-second scaling design with incumbent fallback
required_before_submission: expected benefit over own 69.570 baseline and current public frontier
